title: Prime avoidance for an element good for a regular sequence and cutting a prescribed parameter
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $M\ne0$ be a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. For any module $N$, its support is the set of primes $\mathfrak p$ such that $N_{\mathfrak p}\ne0$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]; dimension is the supremum of prime-inclusion chain lengths. Let $n\ge0$ be an integer with $\dim\operatorname{Supp}(M)=n+2$. Let $f_1,\ldots,f_{n+2}\in\mathfrak m$ be an $M$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Let $g\in R$ satisfy $\dim(\operatorname{Supp}(M)\cap V(g))=n+1$, where $V$ denotes the set of primes containing all listed elements. Then there is $x\in\mathfrak m$ such that $\dim(\operatorname{Supp}(M)\cap V(x,f_1,\ldots,f_i))=n+1-i$ for $0\le i<n+2$, and $\dim(\operatorname{Supp}(M/xM)\cap V(g))=n$.

proof.text: For 0<=i<n+2 set Q_i=M/(f_1,...,f_i)M. The prefix is regular: use the regular-list append characterization and local Nakayama. The regular-sequence dimension formula, implemented by Module.supportDim_add_length_eq_supportDim_of_isRegular in Mathlib.RingTheory.KrullDimension.Regular, gives dim Supp(Q_i)=n+2-i. The support formula gives dim Supp(M/gM)=n+1. These dimensions are positive.

For every finite module N of positive support dimension, the maximal ideal is not minimal over Ann(N). Indeed all support primes lie below the maximal ideal. If it were minimal, the support-annihilator characterization would force every support prime to equal it, making the support subsingleton and its dimension at most zero. This contradicts positivity; the argument is written in maximal_not_minimal_of_supportDim_pos.

The annihilators of the finitely many Q_i and of M/gM form a finite set of ideals. Each has finitely many minimal primes by Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing, the ideal form of the finite-minimal-primes theorem (equivalently apply it to R/I). Their finite union consists of primes strictly below the maximal ideal by the preceding step. Finite prime avoidance supplies x in the maximal ideal outside them all. The finite-family argument is proved in exists_avoid_minimalPrimes.

Apply Module.supportDim_quotSMulTop_succ_eq_of_notMem_minimalPrimes_of_mem_maximalIdeal to each Q_i and to M/gM. Thus quotienting by x drops each displayed dimension by one. The support-quotient formula identifies Supp(Q_i/xQ_i) with Supp(M) intersect V(x,f_1,...,f_i), giving goodness, and identifies Supp((M/gM)/x(M/gM)) with Supp(M/xM) intersect V(g), giving dimension n. Cancellation in WithBot ENat supplies the displayed equalities, including n=0 and i=n+1.

theorem exists_good_element_cutting_parameter
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Nontrivial M]
    (n : ℕ) (hM : supportDim R M = (((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (fs : List R) (hlen : fs.length = n + 2)
    (hmem : ∀ f ∈ fs, f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular M fs)
    (g : R)
    (hcut : Order.krullDim (support R M ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ({g} : Set R) :
      Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) = (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ x : R, x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < n + 2 →
        Order.krullDim (support R M ∩
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus {r : R | r ∈ x :: fs.take i} : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) =
            (((n + 2 - i - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) ∧
      Order.krullDim (support R (QuotSMulTop x M) ∩
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ({g} : Set R) : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) =
          (((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)
